mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial output (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic upturn that increases corporate earnings growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 3-month moving average and INDPRO > 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and INDPRO are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In the early phase of a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% and increasing for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 5 days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS increase in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during the early tightening cycle as defined by the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A rising nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.3 million units, it signals strong consumer confidence and durable goods demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.3.

mechanism_narrative: A robust industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market and strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average and UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which signals potential economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days during industrial contraction regimes.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declining for 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100 and declining for 2 months.
